title: How to Get a Custom 3D-Printed Part That Actually Fits
seo_title: Custom 3D Printed Parts in Durham Region | Getting the Fit Right
description: Custom 3D printed parts in Durham Region and the Kawarthas: what to measure, what to photograph, how material choice affects fit, and why a good part takes more than one print.
excerpt: A replacement clip, a mount for a camera, an adapter between two things that were never meant to connect. Here is what decides whether a printed part fits the first time, and why the second print is usually the one you keep.
